script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the tenants had the place all to themselves or for how long.
Calling the son the one closest to the landowner adds a relationship detail the text does not give.
Saying the passage is meant to feel heavy guesses at the intended effect, which the text does not state.
The tenants want the son's inheritance. The text does not say it is the whole estate.
Saying the baker has a kind heart assumes something about the individual from the answer they picked.
The text says the builders rejected the stone, not that they threw it out.
The text does not say whether the stone was carried away before becoming the cornerstone.
The text does not say the chief priests and Pharisees looked around or that people were watching them.
The text does not say whether anyone had a weapon or that the people were watching.
